_note: Assembled from product/recent-deals/inputs/ (team files finalized 2026-10-26). Every graded input is dated on or before announced_on.

replacement_cost.source_label: HVS U.S. Hotel Development Cost Survey 2026, Exhibit 6, median total incl. land
replacement_cost.replacement_basis: HVS 2026 full-service median including land, $467,244; single class

spread.missing: No trailing-12-month cap rate or NOI disclosed; the 8-K pro forma columns aren't NOI.

supply.missing: No single public source gave the market's total hotel pipeline (under construction plus planned) as a share of existing rooms by the announcement date; figures aren't combined across sources or stages.

demand.source_label: Las Vegas Stadium Authority room tax report, board packet Aug 20, 2026
demand.label: preliminary
demand.period: Clark County (unincorporated) Stadium District room tax, Jul 2025 to Jun 2026 vs prior 12, as printed; June 2026 data marked preliminary

debt_context.summary: Pressured seller without formal distress: AHT's 10-Q (Aug 12, 2026) states substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern and names hotel sales as a source of cash. The closing 8-K filed Oct 1, 2026 (sale closed Sep 25) says about $41.2M went to the lender on a seven-hotel loan; rubric v1 has no category for proceeds to a lender unless the sale was lender-negotiated, which isn't stated.

also_sources.label: AHT 8-K filed Oct 1, 2026: ~$41.2M paid to the mortgage lender

debt_context.summary: Documented trigger at announcement: the closing 8-K filed Oct 1, 2026 says about $41.2M of the roughly $43.5M price was paid to the mortgage lender. Scored at the v1 lender-negotiated band (2); v1.1 doesn't say which band a trigger takes.

v1.1._note: v1.1: supply graded from LVCVA's own bulletin (net of closures; single public-body source). Other factors as v1. Revision 2 (2026-11-01, QA): 11,471 and 7.63% labelled our calculation.

supply.source_label: LVCVA Las Vegas Tourism Construction Bulletin, as of May 15, 2026 (posted May 21, 2026)
supply.pipeline_definition: LVCVA Construction Bulletin as of May 15, 2026: 7,604 net new rooms scheduled for 2026 to 2030 plus 3,867 in announced and proposed projects; our calculation: 11,471 rooms vs 150,300 rooms in inventory at Dec 31, 2025
